snippet.title: Ship v Maze  - Release Announcement
snippet.description:
I'm proud to announce that Ship v Maze will be released on April 2nd, 2026 on Steam.

Fly. Crash. Repeat. Fly a ship through endless mazes at ever-increasing speeds and avoid obstacles as long as you can. Then do better next time.

Try the demo version now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4113380/Ship_v_Maze/
